strategy_roster.name: Volume Supertrend
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(10) and volume above its 20-bar average proxy the SuperTrend/volume-surge direction. The documented 2% stop is retained; ATR SuperTrend state and any trailing implementation are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: RAVIiAO Strategy (StockSharp)
strategy_roster.entry_long: (ema(close,9) - sma(close,21)) / sma(close,21) > 0.1 and (high + low) / 2 > sma((high + low) / 2,5)
strategy_roster.exit_long: (ema(close,9) - sma(close,21)) / sma(close,21) < 0 or (high + low) / 2 < sma((high + low) / 2,5)
strategy_roster.notes: RAVI uses explicit fallback lengths 9/21 and threshold 0.1, while median price versus SMA(5) proxies AC confirmation. Point-based stops, targets, and sizing are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: JK BullP AutoTrader
strategy_roster.notes: Distance above EMA(13) proxies Bull's Power, and a falling three-bar distance captures weakening bullish pressure. Pip stop, target, and trailing settings are not percentage exits.

strategy_roster.name: IBS RSI CCI v4 X2
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(50) is an explicit slow-bias proxy and MACD 12/26/9 preserves the documented counterintuitive fast envelope cross. The IBS/RSI/CCI composite, two timeframes, thresholds, and point protection are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Hancock RSI Volume
strategy_roster.notes: Rising regular RSI(14) replaces the unavailable volume-weighted RSI, with the documented 0.1 slope threshold. Bullish/bearish volume and wick weighting are not reproduced.

strategy_roster.name: Hardcore FX Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: A prior 17-bar extreme proxies the last ZigZag pivot, and the mean band supplies a long exit. The 1400/5400/500 point stop, target, and trail are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Session Breakout Scalper Trading Bot
strategy_roster.notes: A 20-bar session-range fallback and ATR(14) expansion preserve breakout behavior. The 01:00-02:00 clock, 100/50 point targets, and 2-ATR dynamic stop are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Symbol Swap Panel
strategy_roster.notes: The documented panel only switches and monitors a security and never places orders, so an impossible negative-price guard preserves that behavior. Manual requests, symbol switching, logs, and timers are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Range Filter Strategy with ATR TP/SL
strategy_roster.notes: Bollinger(20,1.5) is a direct volatility-band proxy for the unavailable range filter. ATR(14) target and stop multipliers are dynamic price distances rather than percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Harmony Signal Flow By Arun
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(5) crossings above 30 and 50 retain the long reversal and neutral-exit proxies. The 15:25 forced close is unavailable, and 100/150 point protections are not percentage fields.
